tex_content.html:
Let $\gamma $ be an $\mathcal L$-geodesic from $x$ to $M_{T_{i-1}}$ with $\mathcal L(\gamma )\leq 3\sqrt{T-T_{i-1}}$. There is $\tau _0\in [\max (\epsilon ^2,T-T_i),T-T_{i-1}-\epsilon ^2]$ such that $R(\gamma (\tau _0))<r_i^{-2}$. \end{claim}
Proof

\sketch If $R\geq r_i^{-2}$ on the displayed interval, Claim 8 gives an $\mathcal L$-lower bound of $4\sqrt{T-T_{i-1}}$, contradicting $\mathcal L(\gamma )\leq 3\sqrt{T-T_{i-1}}$.

□
